svg.title: Agent 0.2.0 — each package's services and the graph kinds it declares

g.text: Agent 0.2.0 — each package's services and the graph kinds it declares
blue = a graph kind (passive) · cream = sensing's, handed to no reader of the mind · green = a service (logic)
solid = writes · dotted = reads · every graph is named by its kind alone, and the catalogue says what each one is
no sensing, no observations. Sensing runs belief's machinery
over each one, and what the domain's transitions conclude
lands in the agent's state as a subject belief in the
domain's words. Only the boundary reads the number:
prediction, and a command sizing a step.
the grounds, the possible worlds and a pass's plan. An
observation never crosses into it; a pass's plan crosses
back out once, published for the executor to adopt.
every reader of the public graphs, the metrics
and history each package emits as events, and the market's
one per reading · linked by sensing:previous
what the rules concluded of a source,
of the kind its runner hands
the rules a package or a domain ships
what every graph IS, itself included
who I am · my roles · my stances
the agent's own state · the subject beliefs
a plan published, adopted by reference
one-shot · what a desire read unmet
a step adopted, over its landing window
